sections.heading: Definitions
sections.text:
(a) In this ordinance, "owner" means a person who keeps a dog at a home in the Borough of Pellam Ridge.
(b) In this ordinance, "handler" means a person paid to walk or board a dog for an owner.

sections.heading: Licences
sections.text:
(a) An owner shall renew the dog licence within thirty (35) calendar days after the licence expires.
(b) An owner shall attach the licence tag to the dog collar.
(c) An owner need not license a guide dog.

sections.heading: Reminders and handlers
sections.text:
(a) Except as provided in Sec. 5, the Borough Clerk shall mail a renewal reminder to each owner on or before February 1, 2027.
(b) A handler shall carry a copy of the dog licence while walking the dog.

sections.heading: Late fees
sections.text:
(a) An owner shall pay a late fee of ten dollars for each late renewal.
(b) The Borough Clerk may reduce the late fee for a first offence.

sections.heading: Reminder exemptions
sections.text: A reminder is not mailed to an owner who has opted out under Sec. 6.

sections.heading: Opting out
sections.text: An owner may opt out of mailed reminders by written request to the Borough Clerk.

sections.heading: Short title
sections.text: This ordinance may be cited as the Pellam Ridge Dog Licence Ordinance.

amendments.instructionText: In Sec. 4(a), strike "fifteen dollars" and insert "twenty dollars".
In Sec. 1, strike subsection (b), the definition of "handler".
